summary: Melbourne industrial AI startup: 'The Intelligence Layer for the Industrial World' / 'the AI operating system for critical infrastructure'. Connects a site's isolated systems (control systems, sensors, maintenance records, production plans) into one view; early warning days before output drops, energy per tonne, data-to-decision time, catching equipment wear so stops can be planned. Sectors: energy and renewables (wind, solar inverters, grid), oil and gas (pumps, compressors, process sensors), manufacturing (furnaces, lines, quality). Tiny team (RocketReach ~4 staff, unverified).
principles_how_we_work: Precision over volume: answers, not more dashboards; every feature has to earn its place
Built for reality: designed for real, high-stakes operations, not demos
Trust through transparency: every recommendation shows its reasoning
